mapper.select: select c.complain_id, cc.category_name, u.complainuser_name, c.complain_status_cd, c.rcpt_dt, c.proc_dt, c.due_dt from t2000_complain c join t2000_complain_user u on c.complainuser_no = u.complainuser_no join t2000_complain_category cc on c.complain_category_id = cc.complain_category_id where c.account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T2000_COMPLAIN ( COMPLAIN_CATEGORY_ID, COMPLAINUSER_NO, ACCOUNT_ID, COMPLAIN_STATUS_CD, DEADLINE_DT, RECEIVER_ACCOUNT_ID ) VALUES ( #{complainCategoryId}, #{complainuserNo}, #{accountId}, #{complainStatusCd}, #{deadlineDt}, #{receiverAccountId} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.*,u.user_name,g.category_name,r.complainuser_name,g.category_url FROM t2000_complain c JOIN t1000_department_work d ON d.complain_category_id = c.complain_category_id JOIN t1000_account a ON a.dept_id = d.department_id join t1000_user u on a.user_no = u.user_no join t2000_complain_category g on g.complain_category_id = c.complain_category_id join t2000_complain_user r on c.complainuser_no = r.complainuser_no WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}
